name: Hutton TLP (first tension leg platform)
description: substructure_type: Conventional TLP, 16 tension legs — first TLP in the world | topside_type: Production topsides with accommodation (later redeployed to Prirazlomnoye) | water_depth: Designed for 100-1,000 m North Sea depths | topside_weight: 46,500-55,000 t when moored; up to 61,580 t floating freely | installation_method: Hull built in Highland Fabricators' Nigg dry dock (north Scotland); deck built at McDermott's Ardersier yard; two parts mated in the Moray Firth in 1984 | contractor: Highland Fabricators (hull); McDermott (deck) | dates: Built early 1980s; mated 1984; 25-year original design life
notes: secondary source Decommissioned as TLP; hull separated from topsides, topsides redeployed to Prirazlomnoye field (Barents Sea)
